responsibility: Declares the public interface for MSP430 device-data handling. It defines the t_msp430_mcu_data structure that records an MCU name, ISA revision, and hardware-multiplier class, exposes the global extracted_mcu_data result, and declares helpers used by the driver and backend to parse MCU names, locate devices.csv, and manipulate support-file paths.
same_name_distinction: Declares the shared MSP430 device-data API and the t_msp430_mcu_data layout consumed by both driver/backend code. Unlike msp430-devices.cc, it does not perform devices.csv discovery or parsing and does not contain the built-in MCU database; it is the interface header for that implementation.
